line: Doot-doot, doot-doot, I see numbers in my head (I’m alive) I like dead people instead
vault_lines: Doot-doot, doot-doot, I see numbers in my head (I'm alive)
meaning:
In a clever way of displaying their affinity for acquiring money, Uzi exclaims that they prefer dead people to people who are alive, a concept reiterated on their 2017 heartbreak-fueled hit “XO TOUR Llif3.” On the song’s chorus, Uzi raps:

Push me to the edge
All my friends are dead

These lines were confirmed by the track’s producer TM88 to be alluding to the dead presidents or founding fathers on dollar bills, all of whom are now deceased.

Both “XO TOUR Llif3” and this track emphasize how Uzi would rather focus so intently on numbers and wealth that the faces on their money have become more familiar to them than anything less materialistic.
